issues.failure_explanation: The abstract asserts that the scheme preserves 'a minimum principle of the specific entropy'. The paper establishes only: positivity of density and internal energy via the assumed admissible set $\mathcal{A}=\{\rho>0, e(\state)>0\}$ for the hyperbolic update, pointwise invariance of $\rho$ and $\varepsilon$ under the source update, and a global (integral) entropy inequality. No theorem, assumption, or proof establishes a pointwise lower bound $s(\rho,e)\ge s_{\min}$ on the fully discrete level; a global entropy dissipation inequality does not imply a minimum principle.

issues.overall_effect: The advertised structure-preservation guarantee in the abstract includes a property (pointwise entropy minimum principle) that no formal content of the paper supports; the abstract claims more than the formal content delivers.
issues.title: Abstract claims a preserved minimum principle of the specific entropy that is never established
issues.why_classification: A local rewording (or adding one standard invariant-domain assumption on the hyperbolic solver) removes the overclaim; every formal result, rate, and advertised regime survives unchanged.

issues.failure_explanation: The proof reduces the estimate to a comparison between the hyperbolic solver's density update and a formal theta-scheme transport density $\tilde\rho_h^{n+\theta}$ driven by the source-update velocity, asserting $\|\tilde\rho_h^{n+\theta}-\rho_h^{n+\theta}\|=\mathcal O(\tau_n^2)$ 'which would need to be verified in detail for the concrete chosen method'. This second-order consistency between two different discretizations of the balance of mass is a necessary, nontrivial step that is never established; the assumed solver properties (conservation, invariant domain, global entropy inequality) do not imply it. The stated rate $\mathcal O(h^2+h^{1+s})$, the improved $\mathcal O(h^3+h^{1+s})$ claim, and the telescoping conclusions drawn from them are therefore unproven.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must prove, for the concrete hyperbolic solver used, the $\mathcal O(\tau_n^2)$ (resp. $\mathcal O(\tau_n^3)$) consistency estimate between the hyperbolic density update and the formal theta-scheme transport with the source-update velocity, or restate the proposition with this as an explicit hypothesis and weaken Corollary cor:added-3 accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: The quantitative justification of the Gauss-law restart strategy (small deviation of the restarted potential and of the potential energy, Corollary cor:added-3) is unreliable; the restart procedure itself remains well defined, but the claimed smallness and convergence rates are unsupported.
issues.title: Gauß-law residual estimate relies on an explicitly unverified O(tau^2) consistency claim
issues.why_classification: A complete resolution requires a genuine, method-specific consistency estimate (or a weakening that degrades the advertised residual rates), which is a contained but nontrivial new argument; the core structure-preservation guarantees do not depend on it, so the loss is limited rather than major.

issues.failure_explanation: The relaxation factor $\{1-\max(0,\delta\mathcal{E}^{n+1}/\mathcal{E}^{n+1}_{\text{kin}})\}^{1/2}$ is real only if $\delta\mathcal{E}^{n+1}\le\mathcal{E}^{n+1}_{\text{kin}}$. The definition provides no hypothesis or branch excluding $\delta\mathcal{E}^{n+1}>\mathcal{E}^{n+1}_{\text{kin}}$ (the potential-energy increase caused by the restart exceeding the available kinetic energy), in which case the base is negative and the square root is not a real number: the update step of the construction is undefined for those inputs, so its input-output contract fails.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the guard/branch that the relaxation is applied only when $0\le\delta\mathcal{E}^{n+1}\le\mathcal{E}^{n+1}_{\text{kin}}$ (or clamp the factor at zero and document the residual energy defect); all other guarantees of the scheme are untouched.
issues.overall_effect: The Gauss-law restart with relaxation is not a well-defined procedure on its full advertised input domain; whenever the restart raises the potential energy by more than the kinetic energy, the prescribed momentum update does not exist.
issues.title: Relaxation update takes a square root of a possibly negative number
issues.why_classification: A local degenerate-case guard (or a documented regime restriction) makes the procedure well defined; no substantive claim, rate, or guarantee of the paper is lost.
